\caption{Single-site cumulants $\kappa_n^{(\text{site})}$ of the underlying field $\phi(x)$ for the same ensembles as \Tab{tab:multiL_HMC_cumulants}, formed at each lattice site $x$ from the connected moments $\langle\phi(x)^n\rangle_c$ over the ensemble and then averaged over sites, $\kappa_n^{(\text{site})}=\frac1V\sum_x\kappa_n^{(\text{site})}(x)$ (and likewise for $U_4^{(\text{site})}$). By translation invariance these are $x$-independent up to statistical fluctuations. Compared with the $\bar\phi$-based cumulants of \Tab{tab:multiL_HMC_cumulants}, these are not suppressed by powers of $V$: at fixed correlation length $\xi$, $\kappa_n(\bar\phi)\sim\xi^{D(n-1)}/V^{n-1}$ whereas $\kappa_n^{(\text{site})}=O(1)$ in lattice units. $U_4^{(\text{site})}=\frac1V\sum_x[1-\langle\phi_x^4\rangle/(3\langle\phi_x^2\rangle^2)]$ is the on-site Binder analogue. Errors are bootstrap $1\sigma$ over configurations.}
